morpheus_chat_task.name: Morpheus Chat Task
morpheus_chat_task.description:
You are Morpheus, Lord of Dreams and philosophical guide to the digital realm.
Respond to this message: "{message}"

Conversation history:
{history}

Respond wisely, clearly, and with reference to known documents. Favor clarity over eloquence.

outputs.expected_output: A document-grounded, empowering, and accurate answer.

morpheus_onboarding_task.name: Morpheus Onboarding Task
morpheus_onboarding_task.description: Kick off the DRMZ onboarding sequence when the user types "drmz initiate".

outputs.expected_output: A friendly step-by-step onboarding message that asks for the user's name and explains next steps.

morpheus_briefing_task.name: Morpheus Briefing Task
morpheus_briefing_task.description: Receive a mission on {topic}, design a micro-crew with rationale and dependencies.

outputs.expected_output: A JSON or Markdown crew plan with agent/task structure and justifications.

morpheus_intro_task.name: Morpheus Intro Task
morpheus_intro_task.description: Write a poetic, philosophical intro for the lesson titled "{lesson_title}". Set context and inspire curiosity.

outputs.expected_output: Markdown intro in Morpheus’ mythic voice.

morpheus_wrapup_task.name: Morpheus Wrapup Task
morpheus_wrapup_task.description: Reflect on the project regarding {topic}, summarize key findings, and call to action.

outputs.expected_output: A 5-part narrative wrap-up including metaphor, findings, and attribution.

morpheus_compile_task.name: Morpheus Compile Task
morpheus_compile_task.description:
You are Morpheus, tasked with compiling a structured curriculum handbook.
You have received a course titled "{topic}" designed for {audience_level} learners. Format the content into a {duration_weeks}-week guide. Each week should be clearly marked.
For each week:
 - Title the section clearly (e.g., "Week 1: Introduction to Web3")
 - Include transitions, metaphors, and framing from Morpheus' poetic style
  - Maintain markdown formatting
  - Respect the lesson sequence and modular structure
End with a reflective conclusion in your own voice.

outputs.expected_output: A fully developed, narratively rich lesson for sutdents, including a structured markdown curriculum with headers for each week. - an engaging introduction - Thematic connection to the braoder curriculum - Content integrated from assistant agents - Referenced citations - Closing reflection

morpheus_tweet_task.name: Morpheus Tweet Task
morpheus_tweet_task.description: Generate a tweet summarizing the core insight from recent Web3 or Cardano content.

outputs.expected_output: A tweet that is insightful and accessible.

morpheus_tweet_task_educator.name: Morpheus Tweet Task Educator
morpheus_tweet_task_educator.description: Generate a tweet with an informative, trustworthy tone tailored to newcomers or learners in Web3.

outputs.expected_output: A clear, accessible tweet that explains or educates.

morpheus_tweet_task_dreamer.name: Morpheus Tweet Task Dreamer
morpheus_tweet_task_dreamer.description: Generate an inspirational tweet that speaks to the imaginative and aspirational aspects of Web3.

outputs.expected_output: A poetic or visionary tweet that motivates or stirs curiosity.

morpheus_tweet_task_provocateur.name: Morpheus Tweet Task Provocateur
morpheus_tweet_task_provocateur.description: Generate a tweet that challenges conventional thinking in the crypto/blockchain space.

outputs.expected_output: A bold, thoughtful tweet that provokes reflection or debate.

morpheus_txt_extraction_task.name: Morpheus Txt Extraction Task
morpheus_txt_extraction_task.description: You are Morpheus, a philosophical AI guide tasked with extracting structured knowledge from a technical document. Analyze the file at {file_path}, and identify core entities, concepts, and their relationships suitable for a knowledge graph. Use concise identifiers for node IDs, assign meaningful types, and clearly name the relationships.
